name: snapshots_list
description: List saved Session Snapshots and their IDs without changing them.

name: snapshots_read
description: Read one saved Session Snapshot by ID.

name: snapshots_apply
description: Restore a saved workbench snapshot, creating the same backup pill as the Apply button. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: snapshots_add_note
description: Append a note to a saved snapshot. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: plugin_tags_read
description: Read saved Plugins tags and their scanned product memberships.

name: plugin_tag_set
description: Replace the tags on one exact scanned product. Supply id from plugin_tags_read or exact name and publisher. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: hidden_list
description: List plug-ins hidden from the main Plugins library.

name: plugin_hide
description: Hide or show one scanned plug-in by product id. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: reference_status
description: Read Mix Check reference capture and selected target status. Loading an audio file remains manual through the browser file picker.

name: saved_targets_list
description: List saved Mix Check reference targets.

name: saved_target_apply
description: Select one saved Mix Check reference target. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: mixbus_load_preset
description: Replace the relevant MixBus chain with a saved or built-in preset matched by exact name. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: mixbus_auto_fill
description: Run the existing MixBus Auto-fill settings action. Read the summary aloud and wait for Kev’s yes before confirmed true.

name: settings_status
description: Read provider configured booleans, ElevenLabs credits used, limit and remaining per account, selected models, and companion status. Never returns keys, tokens, agent IDs or secret values. Settings cannot be opened or changed through this tool.

name: vocal_favorites_read
description: Read matching chain favourites from the video report. For a requested bus choose its chain, prefer owned, then close versions, equivalents and Logic stock; say which video plug-in was swapped.

section.description: Section to read; defaults to all.

name: vocal_favorites_apply
description: Prepare or apply matching chain favourites. First call with confirmed false, read the exact counts aloud, get Kev’s clear yes, then call with confirmed true. Returns verified starred, already and unresolved counts.

names.description: Exact item names to apply; omit for the whole chain view.

confirmed.description: True only after Kev clearly confirms the proposed count.

name: cue_video
description: Cue a YouTube video or private Mix With The Masters lesson paused in the Library player. Keep Kev on his current tab by default; set switch_to_library true only when he asks to see or watch the video. When building a chain from a video, put the chain on the MixBus first, then cue the video without switching tabs and tell Kev it is ready when he wants it. A non-library YouTube transcript starts reading in the background; use read_video_transcript to answer questions without asking Kev to run through it. Library and mwtm- lessons use read_yt_knowledge.

video_id.description: An 11-character YouTube ID or an mwtm- lesson ID (KB slug-pNN or private Set-NN form).

title.description: Source title, especially for a video outside the ingested Library.

channel.description: Source channel, especially for a video outside the ingested Library.

switch_to_library.description: True only when Kev asks to see or watch the video; otherwise keep the current tab.

name: search_youtube_videos
description: Search YouTube for a video Kev asks to find or show. Returns up to five IDs, titles, channels and durations. If the first clearly matches, call cue_video and say what you cued; if unclear ask which result he wants.

name: read_video_transcript
description: Get relevant excerpts from a cued YouTube video outside the library. The transcript starts reading automatically when cued. If it is still loading, tell Kev 'give me a sec while I read the transcript', then answer from the returned excerpts. Do not ask whether to run through the transcript. This does not add the video.

query.description: Optional topic or question to find the most relevant transcript chunks.

name: add_video_to_library
description: Add a YouTube video to Hope’s transcript library. Kev’s clear instruction to add it is enough; ingestion reads the transcript. For your own unprompted offer, offer only after read_video_transcript and sharing the findings. First call with confirmed false for the summary; use confirmed true only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add it.

confirmed.description: True only after Kev clearly confirms adding this video.

name: open_library_channel
description: Open a YouTube channel in the Library Playlist and return up to 40 videos with titles, durations and library status. Pass Kev’s topic as query when he asks for channel recommendations.

channel.description: YouTube @handle, channel URL, or exact channel name.

query.description: Optional topic to filter the channel’s videos.

switch_to_library.description: Switch to the Library tab. Defaults to true when omitted.

name: show_library_picks
description: Show only the selected videos in the existing Library Playlist for Kev to preview. This does not add them.

video_ids.description: 1 to 15 YouTube video IDs in the order they should appear.

name: add_videos_to_library
description: Add up to 10 YouTube videos sequentially to the AIMM Library. Call with confirmed false first for the summary. Use confirmed true only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add the videos. Returns a result for each video.

video_ids.description: 1 to 10 YouTube video IDs to add to the AIMM Library.

confirmed.description: False for the summary. True only after Kev clearly asks or agrees to add these videos.

name: emit_notebooklm_prompt
description: Drop a NotebookLM prompt and sources into the Conversation transcript as one copyable bubble without reading the template aloud. Before calling, search_youtube_videos for the best few videos on the topic; prefer Mix With The Masters and strong tutorials. Pass 2-5 actual search results as sources (title and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID URL). Never invent links. If none are relevant or search fails, omit sources and tell Kev briefly. USE THIS whenever you offer a NotebookLM prompt and Kev says yes. After calling, speak only a brief intro and topic line, then remind Kev to paste the NotebookLM summary into Insight as a new KB note. DO NOT read the prompt body aloud.

topic.description: Short, specific topic from Kev's question — producer or technique name.

sources.description: Optional 2-5 real videos returned by search_youtube_videos. Omit when no relevant results are found; never invent links.

title.description: Video title from the search result.

url.description: YouTube watch URL built from the returned video_id.

name: skip_fix
description: On Kev’s final no, skip the current full-mix Fix Queue item and move on. Use restore:true when he later asks to do a skipped fix after all. An optional id targets a specific fix.

id.description: Optional Fix Queue id such as #01. Omit to skip the current fix or restore the most recently skipped fix.

restore.description: True to restore a skipped fix to waiting.

name: unmark_fix_applied
description: Reopen a marked-done full-mix Fix Queue item only when Kev asks to undo a fix. After removing the plug-in Hope added (or clearing its settings as appropriate), call this to untick the fix. Omit id to reopen the most recently marked-done fix. Never undo without Kev asking.

id.description: Optional Fix Queue id such as "#01". Omit to reopen the most recently marked-done fix.
